story_name: Hephaestus's Mastery: Crafting Worth from Rejection
character_description: Hephaestus, craftsman-god with bronze skin scarred from celestial violence, luminous eyes reflecting both creative brilliance and deep sorrow, powerful build contrasting with limping gait. His deformity becomes source of wisdom—in learning to work with limitations, he achieves transcendent mastery.
setting: Divine workshops, forges of power, and spaces where rejected beings create beauty
theme: Finding purpose and transcendent mastery through embracing limitations and rejection

video_prompts: Hephaestus thrown from Olympus by his own mother for being different—physical rejection becoming existential wound.
first_frame_prompt: Hephaestus falls from Olympus, bronze skin burning from divine violence. Luminous eyes reflect profound hurt at rejection by mother—she saw his difference and cast him out. His limping gait becomes permanent reminder of abandonment. Yet in falling, something shifts. The pain becomes teacher.
speech: Rejected. Broken. Yet I still exist. Perhaps I can create meaning from this.

His craft becomes language of transformation.
speech: I create for those who are rejected, broken, seeking meaning in limitation.
